photos.alt: A row of small children in Halloween costumes, including a princess in white, a hooded ninja and a superhero, stand holding jack-o-lantern buckets in front of a brick building in soft evening light, with parents and older kids behind them.
photos.colors: brick red, white, bright blue, pumpkin orange
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2, busy and joyful, soft overcast evening light with a muted grey pavement. Faces sit at about 30-50% height, so keep the focal near the top half. Keep the headline beside it or on a left-to-right dark scrim; the kids fill the centre, so do not centre text on top. The superhero mask carries a small Marvel-style emblem; do not crop tight on it for a hero. Spare-1 is the graphic alternative.

photos.alt: A long row of orange pumpkins on a grassy field under a clear blue sky, with visitors and trees in the distance.
photos.colors: pumpkin orange, grass green, sky blue
photos.notes: Wide and sunny; sky on top leaves room for a caption or section title. Works well as a full-bleed band behind the trail map, crop with object-position about 50% 60%.

photos.alt: Two small children in a black witch costume and a red devil costume, seen from behind, walk up a leaf-strewn brick path with a jack-o-lantern bucket toward a white front door, with cobwebs draped over the hedge beside them.
photos.colors: brick red, white, black, autumn orange
photos.notes: Back view, no identifiable faces, so it is safe and charming for the trail map section. Landscape 3:2; the white door and brick above the kids give calm space for a caption or numbered pin overlay.

photos.alt: A scalloped paper cup striped in orange, green, purple and black, filled with sour gummy worms and rainbow candy belts, nestled in orange and black shredded foil in front of a curtain of orange and black streamers.
photos.colors: orange, black, pastel pink and mint
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3, bright and punchy. The candy cup sits in the lower half (about 50-80% height), so keep the focal low when cropping to a square or 4:3. Good for the snack menu card; the streamers give a ready-made Halloween backdrop.

photos.alt: Four dark chocolate cupcakes topped with white fondant ghosts with black bead eyes, served on a pale grey square plate on a wooden table.
photos.colors: chocolate brown, ghost white, warm wood
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3, cute and not scary. Neat enough to be shop-made, so caption it as a treat on the snack menu rather than claiming the kids decorated them. Crop to a square around the ghosts.

photos.alt: Two little girls sit on grass among fallen leaves, painting small pumpkins topped with black witch hats, with a paint palette and paint tubes lying beside them.
photos.colors: grass green, leaf brown, cream, soft pink
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2, faces turned down so it stays friendly and anonymous. Perfect for the pumpkin painting craft station.

photos.alt: A white gauze ghost decoration with a simple drawn face hangs on a thread from a branch against a warm golden-orange blur of autumn leaves.
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3, soft and cute rather than scary. Ideal for the decorations or what-to-bring card; the blurred background takes overlaid text well.

photos.alt: Two children toss armfuls of golden autumn leaves into the air in a sunlit garden under dark evergreen trees, one in an owl-eared hat, with the leaves and arms softly blurred by motion.
photos.colors: golden yellow, leaf brown, forest green
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2, kids partly turned away and deliberately motion-blurred, so use it as an atmospheric card or band rather than a sharp detail shot. Energetic game-time mood for the party games or drop-off section.

photos.alt: A child in a magenta top and purple costume holds a large pumpkin decorated with a grinning black vinyl face in both hands, their own face out of frame.
photos.notes: Second hero candidate: tight, graphic and anonymous, orange and grape purple match the page palette. Landscape 3:2.

photos.alt: An overhead flat lay of candy corn heaped in a large pumpkin-shaped orange dish beside two smaller dishes of tiny decorative pumpkins on a pale linen cloth.
photos.notes: Texture and detail shot with plenty of calm pale space around it. Good behind the snack menu or as a card header.

photos.alt: A small girl in a dark jacket and red skirt stands in a carpet of fallen orange leaves under golden autumn trees, with other children playing further back.
photos.notes: Atmosphere shot, portrait 3:4, warm golden light and children small in the frame. Good for the what-to-bring or parents info section.

photos.alt: Three children, one in a red pointed hat and black cape, one in a black eye mask and one in a tulle cape, sit at a wooden table in a backyard decorated for Halloween, with pumpkins, hay bales, black candles and string lights between the trees.
photos.colors: forest green, hay gold, pumpkin orange, black
photos.notes: Backyard Halloween party scene, landscape 3:2, sharp and editorial; moodier and more witchy than the slot photos, so use it for the venue, hosts or RSVP section rather than the bright hero. Faces are small or turned away.
